title: Implement a Go stack data structure
description: Implement a generic-free Go Stack with Push, Pop, Peek, Size, and IsEmpty. All methods have panic stubs.

task_spec.prompt:
Implement the Stack methods in stack.go:
1. Push(item): append item to s.items
2. Pop(): remove and return last item; panic if empty
3. Peek(): return last item without removing; panic if empty
4. Size(): return len(s.items)
5. IsEmpty(): return len(s.items) == 0

Run `go test ./...` to verify all 3 tests pass.
success_criteria: IsEmpty correct for empty and non-empty
followup_prompts: Run `go test ./...` and show me which tests are passing and which are still failing. Fix any failures — pay attention to edge cases like empty input, boundary values, and error conditions.
Final check: run `go test ./...` one more time. All tests must be green. If anything is still failing, trace through the failing assertion and fix it now.
